guards.guard: sun/moon membership is a closed fourteen-fourteen inventory; it decides only whether assimilation is possible, never whether it happened
an assimilation-completed claim requires an observed written shadda; an unmarked sun-letter surface withholds the claim instead of assuming it
a shadda observed on a moon letter is a contradiction of the closed inventory and is refused, never resolved as assimilation
the article's written laam stays article-owned in every outcome; assimilation is never re-attributed to the following consonant and never read as a doubled root or Form II
no declared article means out of regime; the table never activates on following-letter evidence alone
